turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Wednesday going in Portland? Are the high school chemistry students keeping you busy today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, they are. We're doing a lab today, so it's been pretty active. I'm glad I had a good breakfast to start the day—I made a yogurt parfait this morning.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a delicious way to fuel up! Did you manage to get some exercise in today as well, or was the lab your workout?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haha, the lab is active, but I wanted a real workout. I went after school and did some gym weights.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good for you for making time for gym weights! How is Grace doing today? Did she join you, or is she having a quieter evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She had a busy day too, so she skipped the workout. She's just looking forward to relaxing tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I don't blame her at all. Do you two have any plans to watch anything tonight to wind down?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes. We're going to put on a nature documentary in a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great, peaceful way to end the day. Have you had any chance to spend time on your woodworking lately, or has school been taking up all your free time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: With grading and lesson planning, I haven't been in the garage much. Hopefully, I'll get back to my woodworking this weekend.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Fingers crossed you get some quality workshop time soon! Enjoy the rest of your evening with Grace.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. Have a good night!
